items.title: Komşumuz
items.text: Our neighbor is Hasan. He lives alone in the flat under us. He is sixty years old. Every morning he goes out at eight with his newspaper and he sits in the small cafe on our street. He comes home at eleven. In the afternoon he works in front of the building. He waters the flowers and he cleans the door. Nobody asks him to do it. When my mother makes too much food, she gives some to him. He always says thank you and he brings us bread the next day.
items.textTr: Komşumuz Hasan. Altımızdaki dairede yalnız yaşıyor. Altmış yaşında. Her sabah sekizde gazetesiyle çıkıyor ve sokağımızdaki küçük kafede oturuyor. On birde eve dönüyor. Öğleden sonra binanın önünde çalışıyor. Çiçekleri suluyor ve kapıyı temizliyor. Kimse ondan bunu istemiyor. Annem fazla yemek yaptığında ona da veriyor. Hep teşekkür ediyor ve ertesi gün bize ekmek getiriyor.

questions.q: Where does Hasan live?
questions.note: "He lives alone in the flat under us."

questions.q: What does he take to the cafe?
questions.note: "He goes out at eight with his newspaper."

questions.q: What does he do in the afternoon?
options: Works in front of the building
questions.note: "In the afternoon he works in front of the building."

questions.q: Who asks him to clean the door?
questions.note: "Nobody asks him to do it."

questions.q: What does he give the family?
questions.note: "He brings us bread the next day."

items.title: Kışlık ceket
items.text: Last week I went shopping with my mother. I needed a winter coat. My old coat was too small. We went to three shops. In the first shop the coats were beautiful but too expensive. In the second shop there was nothing in my size. In the third shop I found a black coat. It was warm and it was not expensive. My mother said the color was boring. I said black is good with everything. We bought it. Now I wear it every day and my mother says it was a good choice.
items.textTr: Geçen hafta annemle alışverişe gittim. Kışlık bir cekete ihtiyacım vardı. Eski ceketim çok küçüktü. Üç dükkâna gittik. İlk dükkânda ceketler güzeldi ama çok pahalıydı. İkinci dükkânda benim bedenimde hiçbir şey yoktu. Üçüncü dükkânda siyah bir ceket buldum. Sıcaktı ve pahalı değildi. Annem rengin sıkıcı olduğunu söyledi. Ben siyahın her şeyle iyi gittiğini söyledim. Onu aldık. Şimdi her gün giyiyorum ve annem iyi bir seçim olduğunu söylüyor.

questions.q: Why did the writer need a coat?
options: The old one was too small
questions.note: "My old coat was too small."

questions.q: What was wrong with the first shop?
options: There was nothing in her size
questions.note: "The coats were beautiful but too expensive."

questions.q: What was the problem in the second shop?
questions.note: "There was nothing in my size."

questions.q: What did the mother say about the coat?
questions.note: "My mother said the color was boring."

questions.q: What does the mother say now?
questions.note: Son cümle.

items.title: Müzik dersi
items.text: I have a music lesson on Tuesdays after school. My teacher is Selin. She teaches me the guitar. My first lesson was very difficult. My fingers hurt and I could not play one song. Selin said this is not a problem. Now I can play four songs. I practice for twenty minutes every evening. My brother closes his door because he says it is loud. In June there is a small concert at the music school. All the students play one song. I am not ready but Selin says I will be ready.
items.textTr: Salı günleri okuldan sonra müzik dersim var. Öğretmenim Selin. Bana gitar öğretiyor. İlk dersim çok zordu. Parmaklarım acıdı ve bir şarkı bile çalamadım. Selin bunun sorun olmadığını söyledi. Şimdi dört şarkı çalabiliyorum. Her akşam yirmi dakika çalışıyorum. Kardeşim kapısını kapatıyor çünkü sesin yüksek olduğunu söylüyor. Haziranda müzik okulunda küçük bir konser var. Bütün öğrenciler bir şarkı çalıyor. Hazır değilim ama Selin hazır olacağımı söylüyor.

questions.q: When is the music lesson?
questions.note: "I have a music lesson on Tuesdays after school."

questions.q: What was difficult in the first lesson?
questions.note: "My fingers hurt and I could not play one song."

questions.q: How many songs can she play now?
questions.note: "Now I can play four songs."

questions.q: Why does her brother close his door?
options: He does not like the song
questions.note: "He says it is loud."

questions.q: What happens in June?
questions.note: "In June there is a small concert at the music school."

items.title: Yeni telefon
items.text: For my birthday my parents gave me a phone. It is my first phone. I was very happy. The first day I looked at it for five hours. My father was not happy about that. Now we have a rule in our house. No phones at dinner. No phones after ten o'clock at night. At first the rule was difficult for me. My friend Baran writes to me in the evening and I cannot answer. But now I sleep better and I read more. The rule is good but I do not say that to my father.
items.textTr: Doğum günümde ailem bana bir telefon verdi. İlk telefonum. Çok mutlu oldum. İlk gün beş saat ona baktım. Babam bundan memnun olmadı. Şimdi evimizde bir kural var. Yemekte telefon yok. Gece ondan sonra telefon yok. Başta kural bana zor geldi. Arkadaşım Baran akşamları yazıyor ve cevap veremiyorum. Ama şimdi daha iyi uyuyorum ve daha çok okuyorum. Kural iyi ama bunu babama söylemiyorum.

questions.q: Who gave the phone?
questions.note: "My parents gave me a phone."

questions.q: What did he do on the first day?
options: Looked at it for five hours
questions.note: "The first day I looked at it for five hours."

questions.q: What is the rule at dinner?
questions.note: "No phones at dinner."

questions.q: What is better now?
options: He sleeps better and reads more
questions.note: "Now I sleep better and I read more."

questions.q: What does he not tell his father?
options: That he wants a new phone
questions.note: Son cümle.

items.title: Denizde bir gün
items.text: Last August we went to Antalya for one week. The hotel was old but the sea was in front of it. Every morning I got up at seven and I ran on the sand. The water was warm. My mother does not swim so she read her book under a tree. My father made friends with a man from another hotel and they played cards for hours. In the evening we ate fish in a small restaurant. On the last day I did not want to go home. But school started in two weeks.
items.textTr: Geçen ağustos bir haftalığına Antalya'ya gittik. Otel eskiydi ama deniz önündeydi. Her sabah yedide kalkıp kumda koştum. Su sıcaktı. Annem yüzmez, o yüzden bir ağacın altında kitabını okudu. Babam başka bir otelden bir adamla arkadaş oldu ve saatlerce kâğıt oynadılar. Akşamları küçük bir lokantada balık yedik. Son gün eve gitmek istemedim. Ama okul iki hafta sonra başlıyordu.

questions.q: How long was the holiday?
questions.note: "We went to Antalya for one week."

questions.q: What did the writer do every morning?
questions.note: "I got up at seven and I ran on the sand."

questions.q: What did the mother do?
options: Read her book under a tree
questions.note: "She read her book under a tree."

questions.q: What did the father do?
options: Played cards with a new friend
questions.note: "They played cards for hours."

questions.q: How did the writer feel on the last day?
options: He did not want to go home
He was happy to go home
questions.note: "On the last day I did not want to go home."
